name: TieOutBench v1
description: This dataset is the exact repository snapshot behind the technical report "TieOutBench: Measuring whether an LLM's finance work ties out - before deciding whether to trust it" (SSRN abstract 7243025, August 2026). It is the state of the public repository at git commit b965426 (2026-08-12), the version the report's numbers were produced from.
